title: Embedded payments and stored-value wallet platform
problem: Merchants needed to take card, wallet and BNPL payments behind one integration, and onboarding could not depend on a manual review queue.
whatWeDid: Built from zero: self-serve onboarding with automated KYC document verification, KYC-verified adult and child wallets, subscription billing, PCI-DSS compliance, and fraud and anomaly detection across payments and reward balances. Checkout conversion was the metric; payment-method mix decided what got built next.
measured: 0 → 150+ merchants and 100K+ transactions in four months of launch.

metric.label: merchants and 100K+ transactions, four months after launch

title: Loyalty and retention engine for enterprise retailers
problem: Enterprise retailers, including a Gulf property group, wanted repeat purchase without reward fraud eating the margin.
whatWeDid: Reward rules, tiers and gamification with fraud-risk mitigation designed in, across enterprise programmes on several continents.
measured: Up to 5× increase in repeat transactions.

metric.label: repeat transactions across enterprise loyalty programmes

title: Storefront and growth product
problem: A storefront that acquired customers but did not keep them.
whatWeDid: A/B and multivariate testing on the journey from first visit to repeat order; funnel instrumentation so every change was validated rather than asserted.
measured: 75% more repeat customers in two months, alongside 40% monthly acquisition growth.

title: Personalisation and image-search engine
problem: Recommendations and visual search that had to prove their return in the client’s numbers, not in a demo.
whatWeDid: Recommendation and image-search models with evaluation before release, production monitoring, retraining and version rollout owned end to end.
measured: Up to 261× client ROI. Shipped an image-search model into production.

metric.label: client ROI, upper bound, from recommendation and image search

title: Inventory, POS and quick-commerce at scale
problem: Retailers across MENAP needed one stock position, a point of sale that worked in every store, and a mobile channel.
whatWeDid: Distributed inventory across retailers, a cloud POS, and a quick-commerce mobile app that powered a network reaching millions of small businesses.
measured: Distributed inventory for 60+ retailers; cloud POS in 100+ locations; a mobile channel reaching 10M SMEs across MENAP.

metric.label: cloud POS locations; distributed inventory for 60+ retailers

title: Agentic software-delivery framework on Claude Code
problem: An engineering practice wanted to deliver faster without losing review, tests and documentation along the way.
whatWeDid: An end-to-end pipeline on Claude Code: project planning, automated epic and story population with progress tracking, autonomous story implementation, a dedicated solutions-architect agent, guardrail enforcement, automated code review and test generation, living documentation, and human-in-the-loop escalation pushed to mobile when a decision needs a person.
measured: Rolled out to 10 engineers and now the practice’s default path for new work. Two Android apps scoped at five developers were shipped by one, on the original timeline.

metric.label: engineers on the agentic path; two apps scoped at five developers, shipped by one

title: Multi-tenant digital signage platform, one engineer
problem: A company needed its own signage product: tenants, a CMS, a player it controlled, and devices that keep working offline.
whatWeDid: Multi-tenant backend and CMS, a custom Android (AOSP) player, offline-first device sync over MQTT, an MCP-based AI concierge, credit-based AI monetisation and a white-label reseller tier, on a lean deployment stack. Architected and built by one engineer.
measured: Live in production with its first tenant, one of Lahore’s fastest-growing restaurant chains.

title: Signage platform across four continents
problem: A UK signage business operating across Australia, the US, China and APAC needed a platform its display-manufacturer partners could plug into.
whatWeDid: .NET 6 microservices and Angular on AWS (EKS, ECR, RDS, CloudWatch) with Docker-based CI/CD. Scheduled sync integrations with SharePoint, Power BI and partner sources. Production infrastructure stabilised under sustained memory pressure ahead of a database end-of-support migration.
measured: Shipped and running across four regions; partner integrations for three major display manufacturers — [ADD UPTIME / DEVICES].

title: Preclinical research portal for global labs
problem: Preclinical data was growing exponentially across labs and formats; nobody could compare it, let alone predict from it.
whatWeDid: A compliant cloud architecture with custom ETL to harmonise heterogeneous lab data. Machine-learning models for predicting therapeutic response and model relevance. Dashboards and real-time visualisation for researchers.
measured: Data analysis time down 60%. 100% of data visible across global teams. Predictive accuracy up.

metric.label: less analysis time on preclinical data across global labs

title: Surgical imaging platform with automated analysis
problem: Surgeons and clinicians needed one workflow for patient imaging, with analysis that did not wait for a human to open every file.
whatWeDid: Two backends where each fits: Node.js/Express for workflow, Python/FastAPI for the models. Computer-vision analysis of medical images (OpenCV, TensorFlow). Role-based access and HIPAA-grade handling of patient data. PostgreSQL, imaging files on AWS S3, a real-time React front end.
measured: Workflow time and review backlog, before and after — [ADD THE NUMBER]. Source states: workflow efficiency up, data fully secured.

title: Omnichannel loyalty platform on microservices
problem: A loyalty programme that had to take high transaction volumes across channels without slowing the checkout.
whatWeDid: Microservices per loyalty function. Django REST Framework and React. AWS SQS/SNS for messaging, Celery for background work, Redis and Redshift caching for low-latency reads, OAuth for authentication, gRPC and GraphQL between services and clients.
measured: High transaction volumes at low latency — [ADD p95 AND VOLUME].

title: Organic revenue engine for an online store
problem: A WooCommerce/Shopify store with almost no organic sales.
whatWeDid: Collection-based keyword targeting across product and category pages, AI-assisted content at scale, caching for fast checkout, and CRO on the checkout funnel.
measured: Monthly revenue from $2,000 to $12,000 in six months — 6×, organic only.

metric.label: monthly revenue in six months, organic only

title: Health-insurance platform under supervision
problem: A regulated insurer needed a digital platform that a supervisor would sign off and a member could actually use.
whatWeDid: Mapped the underwriting and claims workflow before designing against it; balanced regulatory constraints against a usable member journey, from discovery to launch.
measured: Launched under regulatory supervision — [ADD MEMBERS / CLAIMS].

title: Online therapy platform, concept to public launch
problem: Remote therapy for marginalised communities: practitioners and patients, scheduling, consent, sessions.
whatWeDid: Practitioner and patient journeys, scheduling, consent and remote sessions, taken from concept to public launch.
measured: Publicly launched — [ADD SESSIONS / PRACTITIONERS].

title: Preventive alerting in nursing homes
problem: Care staff found out too late. Sensors could tell them earlier, if the alerts were trusted.
whatWeDid: An IoT preventive-alerting product piloted and deployed across multiple nursing homes and validated in real care settings before scaling.
measured: Deployed across multiple homes — [ADD HOMES / ALERT PRECISION].

title: LLM and RAG assistant in a live customer journey
problem: A UK deals platform had inbound support volume it could see in its tickets.
whatWeDid: An assistant sourced from support-ticket analysis rather than a feature request, embedded in the live journey, with quality gates before release.
measured: Reduced inbound support volume — [ADD THE NUMBER].

title: Detection from user-submitted photographs
problem: Non-experts photographing in poor conditions; a model that had to act on what they sent.
whatWeDid: Owned the labelled dataset strategy, the evaluation criteria that gated release, production monitoring and the retraining loop as field data arrived; capture guidance and failure handling treated as part of the product. Localised for low-literacy users.
measured: 98% detection accuracy. Government incubator funding secured on the minimum viable build.

title: Developer platform exposing device telemetry
problem: A global hardware company wanted third parties building on its device telemetry through public APIs.
whatWeDid: Led the core API team: design, versioning, partner onboarding and documentation.
measured: Public API programme live with third-party partners — [ADD PARTNERS / CALLS].

title: Process-documentation platform backend
problem: A browser-extension product that writes process documentation from recorded sessions, with a milestone that could not slip.
whatWeDid: Owned Lambda and hosted worker services (SQS, SNS) across environments and led the refactor that shipped the critical milestone on deadline.
measured: Critical milestone shipped on the date.

title: Retailer replenishment SDK
problem: Retailers integrating a replenishment service each failed in their own way.
whatWeDid: .NET Core microservices on Azure Service Fabric with EF Code First, plus an admin module that resolved SDK-level failures across retailer integrations.
measured: SDK in production across retailer integrations — [ADD RETAILERS].

title: Marketing data consolidated into ML-ready datasets
problem: Marketing data scattered across sources, none of it ready for a model.
whatWeDid: An R&D engagement on AWS Glue and Athena consolidating marketing data into ML-ready S3 datasets.
measured: ML-ready datasets delivered — [ADD SOURCES / VOLUME].

title: Real-time operational intelligence for 200+ buildings
problem: Building operators needed live operational data, not last month’s report.
whatWeDid: Product leadership of a telemetry platform delivering real-time operational intelligence across a large building estate.
measured: Powering 200+ buildings.

metric.label: buildings on one real-time operational telemetry platform

title: Small language models where an LLM was too expensive
problem: An accuracy target that a large model met at a cost the business could not.
whatWeDid: Shipped a product on small language models as a cost-effective alternative, weighing accuracy against inference cost.
measured: Accuracy target met at a fraction of the inference cost — [ADD COST / ACCURACY].

title: Autonomous development pipeline for Dynamics 365
problem: Customising a CRM platform end to end without a team of specialists.
whatWeDid: Provisioned a full Dataverse environment and Azure AD app registration, then authored the project blueprint covering three MCP servers and plugin lifecycle management, letting an agent drive customisation end to end.
measured: Agent-driven customisation running end to end.

title: Real-time freight dispatch and load board
problem: Dispatchers were assigning loads from stale data; delays and errors compounded through the day.
whatWeDid: WebSockets for instant load status, driver availability and assignments. Live vehicle tracking and route planning on Google Maps. A modular React load board with revenue and broker-performance analytics over GraphQL/Apollo.
measured: Dispatch delays and errors down — [ADD THE NUMBER]. Source states: real-time accuracy, significantly fewer delays and errors.

title: Transporter, driver and customer app
problem: Three very different users — a transporter running finances, a driver on the road, a customer waiting — sharing one product.
whatWeDid: iOS and Android app with a module per role: a transporter hub for loads, invoices and financial overview; a driver interface built for use in motion, with large targets and quick actions; customer visibility. A modular design system in Figma so the three stayed one product.
measured: Fleet coordination and customer visibility improved — [ADD THE NUMBER].

title: P&L forecasting engine with accounting integration
problem: Finance teams wanted forecasts they could trust and adjust, fed straight from their accounting data.
whatWeDid: A Django REST backend with secure APIs for data import, including a XERO integration. A hybrid model: time-series machine learning (SARIMA-class) combined with the team’s own formulas for P&L projection. Built as a secure vault for sensitive projections.
measured: Forecast accuracy against actuals — [ADD THE NUMBER]. Source states: production-ready, customisable, data-driven forecasts.

title: Multi-agent orchestration framework
problem: Several independent AI agents had to work one objective together, reliably, not just in a demo.
whatWeDid: A Streamlit proof of concept first, to validate the idea in days. Then production: FastAPI backend, React front end, LangChain to define agent roles and collaboration flows, OpenAI and Groq models behind them.
measured: Coordinated workflow simulation among autonomous agents, reliably repeatable — [ADD RUNS / SUCCESS RATE].

title: Two brands, one ordering platform and admin
problem: A group running two restaurant brands wanted separate customer experiences and one back office.
whatWeDid: Distinct layouts and menus per brand under a shared design language. A single admin portal for orders, analytics and support across both. A complete design system in Figma so the third brand would be cheap.
measured: Ordering-journey conversion — [ADD BEFORE → AFTER]. Source states: journey optimised for conversion; internal operations centralised.

title: Rental, flights and community in one product
problem: A travel product with admins, influencers and hotel owners, three modules and an AI recommendation layer, needed a system before it needed screens.
whatWeDid: Complete user flows for Rental, Flights and Community. Role-specific journeys. AI-assisted trip discovery designed into the flows rather than bolted on. A design system for web and mobile handoff.
measured: Ready for multi-role management and rapid feature expansion — [ADD SHIP DATE / SCOPE].

title: Funnel analysis and CRO for a large store
problem: A store with over Rs 95M in sales and thousands of orders did not know where the funnel leaked.
whatWeDid: Deep funnel analysis across 1.15M sessions to find drop-offs before checkout. Conversion-rate work at the points that mattered. A data foundation for budget allocation.
measured: 2.05% store conversion held at high traffic. Average order value Rs 6,074. Over Rs 95M total sales analysed.

title: Inbound lead engine for a vehicle marketplace
problem: A UAE vehicle marketplace needed buyer and seller leads without buying every one.
whatWeDid: Intent-based keyword mapping, high-converting landing pages, and vehicle-listing schema for rich results across the Emirates.
measured: 500% growth in qualified inbound leads in six months (audited). Top rankings for buyer and seller intent terms.
